summary: Read a collection of integers that may be unordered and may contain repeats. Values that differ by one form a run even when they are not neighbors in the input. Count a repeated value only once inside a run. Find the longest run and write how many distinct integers it includes. The amount of work must stay proportional to how many integers were read.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
